text: hey the tools/rjit dev server, can we get a copy of that same idea but strictly for game dev, like i dont need to be waiting on a build that links upo postgres or etc. and what we will end up needing at some point later is easy to slot in u can make it a gdev command
resolution: Added a standalone rjit gdev command instead of refactoring rjit dev. gdev defaults to hmsc-int, uses source-driven game native flags from the cart metafile, builds a separate reactjit-gdev host/socket/bundle path, and skips the embedded Postgres bootstrap so game iteration does not link/start unrelated dev services.
